complexity_note: not built (dead at step 0); the proposer / judge estimate was 10.25-11.0 (one pin, one tooth, one sliding pair, one loop); a rolling follower adds one bearing
verdict: DEAD at step 0 (pre-registered kill: no PA-passing pin start leaves the tooth with <= 4 skin-contact poses at a level <= R 64). (1) At the spec law (rho 1.05-1.1) NO single pin-flank pair carries the stroke: over 302,595 pin starts the built drive range from stop A is <= 29.7 deg (crowned pin, mu 0.087) / 35.85 (rolling) against the 44.14 deg the taken poses need; the spec's PA-passing start (r 19 / az 18) crosses the relative pole at K 22.2 and is undercut 1.25 mm over K 0-21.4 (range 0). With the range the best sliding pin can carry (29.7 deg) the law-only ghost reads 31.80 frozen exact Bench(110,360) (221 ws takes). (2) A full-stroke one pair exists only at fast laws: sliding at rho 2.5 with the pin inside hub K's O20 rim (8.7-9.7 mm from uK); rolling at rho 2.0 just outside it (12.9-13.6 mm). Its tooth, 20-30 mm from hub 2's axis, then touches the skin on 19-57 envsel poses at R 61-67 (min -9.4..-18.6 mm), all overhead scaption at the stretched end. (3) The re-seat itself costs 0.55: the law-only ghost reads 18.83 (261 ws takes) frozen exact at rho 1.1, 2.15 and 2.5 alike, vs the lead's 18.28 / 262 - a bound that passes the 19.0 ghost gate, but no buildable drive reaches it.
limiter: (1) THE PITCH POINT (exact spherical kinematics): with a constant law the pin (link 1a) and the flank (link 2) have a fixed relative pole on the uK-u2 arc, ~bk2 / (1 + rho) from uK (14.3 deg at rho 1.1, 8.6 at 2.5); both pressure angles pass 43 - atan(mu) only in a lens around it, and a pin circle about uK stays in that lens for <= 30 deg of K (sliding) / 36 (rolling) at rho 1.1. A full 44-deg stroke needs rho >= 2.0 (rolling) / 2.5 (sliding), which puts the pole - and the pin - at or inside hub K's O20 rim. (2) THE TOOTH SWEEP: the PA-passing contact is 20-30 mm from u2, so the tooth on link 2 sweeps the skin as q2 turns; at the stretched end (overhead scaption, elev 107-150, axial -45..-60) it dips 9-19 mm into the shoulder-top skin at every level up to R 67. Not shape: the ghost (no drive metal) is 18.83.
note: Model docs/concepts/models/shortk-onetooth-knuckle-3r.py loads onetooth-slowlaw-knuckle-3r (itself the verified lead conecut-knee-knuckle-3r, SN_CELL=lead, with its ghost cell and built-flank check) and changes: (a) the K dyad 34 / 30, restored AFTER the lead's chain clamp (roller-longdyad clamps bk1 to [26, 32] and bk2 to [38, 48] - a naive re-seat silently runs 32 / 38; caught by the a1e(K) check); (b) the law anchored on the lead's END STATE (a1e 54.27 at th 106.30, both read from the lead's own kinematics; K 45.62 on the old dyad is a1e 57.33 on the new one), onset solved on the new dyad's exact th(q2, K): rho 1.1 -> th_on 62.26, q2_on 36.76, K_end 44.15 at q2 -3.37 (the spec's 62.2 / 36.9 / 44.2 / -3.3 reproduced); (c) the drive range DKLIM = the K at the lead's wall a1e 55.52 (48.43; K dyad 8.48 deg from its stretch, min over taken 9.74; the spec's 5.23 applies only to a1max 58.77); DKCAP = the built pair's range. A LAW / SEAT change, not a metric change: no bench, judge or kit file touched. Frozen protocol: fit Bench(60,160) fast -> shape frozen -> worn exact on envsel (selection) and Bench(110,360). Fast fit (ghost, rho 1.1): 13.12 plain / 29.60 near-2 (lead-law ghost 12.50 / 18.80). Convergence gate: not a search death - the three full-stroke ghosts (rho 1.1 / 2.15 / 2.5) read 18.83 identically (gain over the 2nd half 0.00, over the last third 0.00, top-3 spread 0.00 points); the kill is the pre-registered step-0 scan plus the kinematic bound over 302,595 pin starts (5 dyads x 5-6 laws x 2 frictions). Red team: the pose that jams - none applies to a ghost; the poses the drive loses are the stretched end (K > 29.7 deg: 40 ws takes, follow 1.0 -> 0.927); the point that pinches - the tooth's end of flank at overhead scaption (envsel 453: 29.7 / 149.6 / -56.5, -18.6 mm on 34/30), and hub 2 at 205 (-4.21) and 139 (-0.49, new vs the lead) on the ghost itself; the optimistic numbers - the 18.83 ghost (no drive metal) and the proposer's proxy (0 tooth contacts at hand-placed patches, no fold rule, no re-fit, no pole). Scripts: docs/research/shortk_onetooth/ (fscan.py pin scan, metal.py tooth / pin skin proxy, framecheck.py, vizbuild.py).
